commit.message:
Svc/golang (#1)

* go mod init backend-go

* Get boilerplate code from gobyexample

* Create CI pipeline for golang svc

* add path to dockerfile

* Upload and download golang binary between steps

* Try to deploy to minikube

* set CGO_ENABLED=0

to avoid dynamic link issue when running go binary

* Edit golang server

- Log before http.ListenAndServe
- listen to port 3000

* Fix helm chart relative path

* Add / handler for k8s health check

* Set default port to 80

* helm chart init http

* add timeout to helm deploy command

* Test the endpoint after deployed to minikube

* Set service.type to NodePort

* Add new line after echo

* Add -s to curl command

* Use gorilla mux

* Add comments

* Add basic test

* Set overall target to 0 for testing purposes

* Relocate comment

* Update .gitignore

* Use upload/download-artifact@v3
